hook.name: SDBR PoolTravada
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions exclusively to the hook contract itself — any external caller's beforeInitialize or beforeAddLiquidity reverts. Functions as a liquidity manager with a fixed 2% fee: the deployer seeds tiered liquidity ranges at launch, users can lock token payments as permanent liquidity via pagar, and accumulated fees are collected to a designated recipient.
